responsibility: Generated documentation-metadata file for the handwritten NVPTX option table nvptx.opt. It lists the NVPTX backend’s command-line options such as -m64, -mmainkernel, -msoft-stack, -muniform-simt, -mgomp, -misa=, -march=, and -mptx= and assigns each a manual URL suffix into the GCC Nvidia PTX options documentation, so GCC’s generated option help/indexing can connect parsed option records to the correct HTML manual anchors.
